blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, brother of Vice President Sara Duterte, was among the individuals who were subpoenaed by the Senate impeachment court, as the prosecution seeks to present more witnesses for second inpeachment article. At the end of Wednesday’s impeachment trial, Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero issued the subpoena for Duterte, Atty. Gerardo del Rosario, of the Securities and Exchange Commission, and other individuals. “We are in receipt of requests for subpoenas ad testificandum and duces tecum […] The Chair hereby grants the request for a subpoena with the following changes: subpoena duces tecum ad testificandum to Attorney del Rosario […]... Keep on reading: Baste Duterte, other witnesses subpoenaed for Sara impeachment trial
